name: model_providers.<id>.env_key_instructions
description: Optional setup guidance for the provider API key.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented model_providers.<id>.env_key_instructions behavior.

name: model_providers.<id>.experimental_bearer_token
description: Direct bearer token for the provider (discouraged; use env_key).
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented model_providers.<id>.experimental_bearer_token behavior.

name: model_providers.<id>.requires_openai_auth
description: The provider uses OpenAI authentication (defaults to false).
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented model_providers.<id>.requires_openai_auth behavior.

name: model_providers.<id>.wire_api
description: Protocol used by the provider. responses is the only supported value, and it is the default when omitted.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented model_providers.<id>.wire_api behavior.

name: model_providers.<id>.query_params
description: Extra query parameters appended to provider requests.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented model_providers.<id>.query_params behavior.

name: model_providers.<id>.http_headers
description: Static HTTP headers added to provider requests.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented model_providers.<id>.http_headers behavior.

name: model_providers.<id>.env_http_headers
description: HTTP headers populated from environment variables when present.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented model_providers.<id>.env_http_headers behavior.

name: model_providers.<id>.request_max_retries
description: Retry count for HTTP requests to the provider (default: 4).
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented model_providers.<id>.request_max_retries behavior.

name: model_providers.<id>.stream_max_retries
description: Retry count for SSE streaming interruptions (default: 5).
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented model_providers.<id>.stream_max_retries behavior.

name: model_providers.<id>.stream_idle_timeout_ms
description: Idle timeout for SSE streams in milliseconds (default: 300000).
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented model_providers.<id>.stream_idle_timeout_ms behavior.

name: model_providers.<id>.supports_websockets
description: Whether that provider supports the Responses API WebSocket transport.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented model_providers.<id>.supports_websockets behavior.

name: model_providers.<id>.supports_standalone_web_search
description: Advertise support for a compatible standalone web search endpoint (default: false). Standalone search remains under development and off by default; provider compatibility alone doesn't enable it.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented model_providers.<id>.supports_standalone_web_search behavior.

name: model_providers.<id>.auth
description: Command-backed bearer token configuration for a custom provider. Do not combine with env_key, experimental_bearer_token, or requires_openai_auth.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented model_providers.<id>.auth behavior.

name: model_providers.<id>.auth.command
description: Command to run when Codex needs a bearer token. The command must print the token to stdout.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented model_providers.<id>.auth.command behavior.

name: model_providers.<id>.auth.args
description: Arguments passed to the token command.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented model_providers.<id>.auth.args behavior.

name: model_providers.<id>.auth.timeout_ms
description: Maximum token command runtime in milliseconds (default: 5000).
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented model_providers.<id>.auth.timeout_ms behavior.

name: model_providers.<id>.auth.refresh_interval_ms
description: How often Codex proactively refreshes the token in milliseconds (default: 300000). Set to 0 to refresh only after an authentication retry.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented model_providers.<id>.auth.refresh_interval_ms behavior.

name: model_providers.<id>.auth.cwd
description: Working directory for the token command.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented model_providers.<id>.auth.cwd behavior.

name: model_providers.amazon-bedrock.aws.profile
description: AWS profile name used by the built-in amazon-bedrock provider.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented model_providers.amazon-bedrock.aws.profile behavior.

name: model_providers.amazon-bedrock.aws.region
description: AWS region used by the built-in amazon-bedrock provider.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented model_providers.amazon-bedrock.aws.region behavior.

name: plan_mode_reasoning_effort
description: Plan-mode-specific reasoning override. When unset, Plan mode uses its built-in preset default.
syntax: plan_mode_reasoning_effort: <none | minimal | low | medium | high | xhigh>
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented plan_mode_reasoning_effort behavior.

name: model_reasoning_summary
description: Select reasoning summary detail or disable summaries entirely.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented model_reasoning_summary behavior.

name: model_verbosity
description: Optional GPT-5 Responses API verbosity override; when unset, the selected model/preset default is used.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented model_verbosity behavior.

name: model_supports_reasoning_summaries
description: Force Codex to send or not send reasoning metadata.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented model_supports_reasoning_summaries behavior.

name: shell_environment_policy.inherit
description: Baseline environment inheritance when spawning subprocesses.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented shell_environment_policy.inherit behavior.

name: shell_environment_policy.ignore_default_excludes
description: Keep variables containing KEY, SECRET, or TOKEN before other filters run (default: true). Set to false to apply automatic secret-name exclusions.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented shell_environment_policy.ignore_default_excludes behavior.

name: shell_environment_policy.filters
description: Canonical case-insensitive environment-variable pattern filters. Include entries create an allowlist and can't restore excluded values. Explicit set values apply after exclusions. Don't combine filters with legacy exclude or include_only arrays in the same layer.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented shell_environment_policy.filters behavior.
when_not_to_use: Avoid this deprecated setting in new configuration; use the documented replacement when available.

name: shell_environment_policy.exclude
description: Legacy environment-variable exclusion patterns. Use shell_environment_policy.filters for new configuration; don't combine both forms in the same layer.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented shell_environment_policy.exclude behavior.
when_not_to_use: Avoid this deprecated setting in new configuration; use the documented replacement when available.

name: shell_environment_policy.include_only
description: Legacy allowlist of environment-variable patterns. Use shell_environment_policy.filters for new configuration; don't combine both forms in the same layer.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented shell_environment_policy.include_only behavior.
when_not_to_use: Avoid this deprecated setting in new configuration; use the documented replacement when available.

name: shell_environment_policy.set
description: Explicit environment values injected after exclusions; include filters can still remove them.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented shell_environment_policy.set behavior.

name: shell_environment_policy.experimental_use_profile
description: Use the user shell profile when spawning subprocesses.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented shell_environment_policy.experimental_use_profile behavior.

name: project_root_markers
description: List of project root marker filenames; used when searching parent directories for the project root.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented project_root_markers behavior.

name: project_doc_max_bytes
description: Maximum bytes read from AGENTS.md when building project instructions.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented project_doc_max_bytes behavior.

name: project_doc_fallback_filenames
description: Additional filenames to try when AGENTS.md is missing.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented project_doc_fallback_filenames behavior.

name: history.persistence
description: Control whether Codex saves session transcripts to history.jsonl.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented history.persistence behavior.

name: tool_output_token_limit
description: Token budget for storing individual tool/function outputs in history.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented tool_output_token_limit behavior.

name: background_terminal_max_timeout
description: Maximum poll window in milliseconds for empty write_stdin polls (background terminal polling). Default: 300000 (5 minutes). Replaces the older background_terminal_timeout key.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented background_terminal_max_timeout behavior.

name: history.max_bytes
description: If set, caps the history file size in bytes by dropping oldest entries.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented history.max_bytes behavior.

name: file_opener
description: URI scheme used to open citations from Codex output (default: vscode).
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented file_opener behavior.

name: otel.environment
description: Environment tag applied to emitted OpenTelemetry events (default: dev).
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented otel.environment behavior.

name: otel.exporter
description: Select the OpenTelemetry exporter and provide any endpoint metadata.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented otel.exporter behavior.

name: otel.trace_exporter
description: Select the OpenTelemetry trace exporter and provide any endpoint metadata.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented otel.trace_exporter behavior.

name: otel.metrics_exporter
description: Select the OpenTelemetry metrics exporter (defaults to statsig).
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented otel.metrics_exporter behavior.

name: otel.log_user_prompt
description: Opt in to exporting raw user prompts with OpenTelemetry logs.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented otel.log_user_prompt behavior.

name: otel.exporter.<id>.endpoint
description: Exporter endpoint for OTEL logs.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented otel.exporter.<id>.endpoint behavior.

name: otel.exporter.<id>.protocol
description: Protocol used by the OTLP/HTTP exporter.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented otel.exporter.<id>.protocol behavior.

name: otel.exporter.<id>.headers
description: Static headers included with OTEL exporter requests.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented otel.exporter.<id>.headers behavior.

name: otel.trace_exporter.<id>.endpoint
description: Trace exporter endpoint for OTEL logs.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented otel.trace_exporter.<id>.endpoint behavior.

name: otel.trace_exporter.<id>.protocol
description: Protocol used by the OTLP/HTTP trace exporter.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented otel.trace_exporter.<id>.protocol behavior.

name: otel.trace_exporter.<id>.headers
description: Static headers included with OTEL trace exporter requests.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented otel.trace_exporter.<id>.headers behavior.

name: otel.exporter.<id>.tls.ca-certificate
description: CA certificate path for OTEL exporter TLS.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented otel.exporter.<id>.tls.ca-certificate behavior.

name: otel.exporter.<id>.tls.client-certificate
description: Client certificate path for OTEL exporter TLS.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented otel.exporter.<id>.tls.client-certificate behavior.

name: otel.exporter.<id>.tls.client-private-key
description: Client private key path for OTEL exporter TLS.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented otel.exporter.<id>.tls.client-private-key behavior.

name: otel.trace_exporter.<id>.tls.ca-certificate
description: CA certificate path for OTEL trace exporter TLS.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented otel.trace_exporter.<id>.tls.ca-certificate behavior.

name: otel.trace_exporter.<id>.tls.client-certificate
description: Client certificate path for OTEL trace exporter TLS.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented otel.trace_exporter.<id>.tls.client-certificate behavior.

name: otel.trace_exporter.<id>.tls.client-private-key
description: Client private key path for OTEL trace exporter TLS.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented otel.trace_exporter.<id>.tls.client-private-key behavior.

name: desktop.custom_file_handlers.<id>
description: User-level only. Defines an additional Open in target for the ChatGPT desktop app. See Add custom file handlers for examples and handler ID constraints.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented desktop.custom_file_handlers.<id> behavior.

name: desktop.custom_file_handlers.<id>.label
description: Display name shown in Open in menus. Required.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented desktop.custom_file_handlers.<id>.label behavior.

name: desktop.custom_file_handlers.<id>.icon
description: Bundled asset path, Base64-encoded data:image/... URL, file URI, or absolute local path for the handler icon. Required; unsupported sources use the default VS Code icon.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented desktop.custom_file_handlers.<id>.icon behavior.

name: desktop.custom_file_handlers.<id>.command
description: Executable path or command name to detect and launch. Required.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented desktop.custom_file_handlers.<id>.command behavior.

name: desktop.custom_file_handlers.<id>.args
description: Arguments inserted between the command and file input (default: []).
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented desktop.custom_file_handlers.<id>.args behavior.

name: desktop.custom_file_handlers.<id>.input
description: How the app sends file input to the handler (default: path).
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented desktop.custom_file_handlers.<id>.input behavior.

name: desktop.custom_file_handlers.<id>.supports_ssh
description: Offer the handler for files in SSH workspaces (default: false).
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented desktop.custom_file_handlers.<id>.supports_ssh behavior.

name: tui
description: TUI-specific options such as enabling inline desktop notifications.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented tui behavior.

name: tui.notifications
description: Enable TUI notifications; optionally restrict to specific event types.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented tui.notifications behavior.

name: tui.notification_method
description: Notification method for terminal notifications (default: auto).
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented tui.notification_method behavior.

name: tui.notification_condition
description: Control whether TUI notifications fire only when the terminal is unfocused or regardless of focus. Defaults to unfocused.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented tui.notification_condition behavior.

name: tui.animations
description: Enable terminal animations (welcome screen, shimmer, spinner) (default: true).
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented tui.animations behavior.

name: tui.alternate_screen
description: Control alternate screen usage for the TUI (default: auto; auto skips it in Zellij to preserve scrollback).
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented tui.alternate_screen behavior.

name: tui.resume_cwd
description: Working directory to use when resuming or forking a session. When unset, Codex asks you to choose if your current directory differs from the session's saved directory.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented tui.resume_cwd behavior.

name: tui.vim_mode_default
description: Start the composer in Vim normal mode instead of insert mode (default: false). You can still toggle it per session with /vim.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented tui.vim_mode_default behavior.

name: tui.raw_output_mode
description: Start the TUI in raw scrollback mode for copy-friendly terminal selection (default: false). You can toggle it with /raw or the default alt-r key binding.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented tui.raw_output_mode behavior.

name: tui.show_tooltips
description: Show onboarding tooltips in the TUI welcome screen (default: true).
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented tui.show_tooltips behavior.

name: tui.status_line
description: Ordered list of TUI footer status-line item identifiers. null disables the status line.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented tui.status_line behavior.

name: tui.terminal_title
description: Ordered list of terminal window/tab title item identifiers. Defaults to ["spinner", "project"]; null disables title updates.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented tui.terminal_title behavior.
